instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Archicad graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, or PowerShell; do not run Python, shell, IfcOpenShell, Archicad API, or other helper scripts; do not create or execute any code or macro that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only Archicad native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Learning Center Drawing Set Start from a blank Archicad project with no init files or local reference images. Build or edit the model using Archicad BIM elements, not visual-only placeholder geometry. Save the completed deliverables in the output folder as result.ifc and result.pdf. Create a two-storey BIM model for the named project. Keep the shaped model within 0.5 m of horizontal extents about X 0 to 10 and Y 0 to 10, with vertical extents about Z 0 to 6.7. Export result.ifc as an IFC4 model with unique GlobalId values for IFC root objects. It must contain exactly 2 building storeys and exactly 7 IfcSpace zones named LOBBY, CLASSROOM-1, OFFICE, WC, STAIR, CLASSROOM-2, and MAKER. Assign LOBBY, CLASSROOM-1, OFFICE, WC, and STAIR on the lower storey; and CLASSROOM-2 and MAKER on the upper storey. Model the required construction as real BIM element classes, including at least 2 IfcSlab elements, at least 1 IfcRoof element, and at least 1 IfcStair element. If an equivalent exporter writes IfcWallStandardCase for walls, that is acceptable. Do not count IfcBuildingElementProxy or other generic proxy objects as satisfying required walls, slabs, roofs, stairs, doors, windows, or spaces. Publish result.pdf as a 3-page drawing set. The visible sheet text must include A101, A201, LEARNING CENTER, CLASSROOM-1, CLASSROOM-2, MAKER, LOBBY, and SECTION so the title, drawing type, and key rooms or zones are identifiable. Other materials, colors, object names, property sets, layer names, relationship nesting, and IFC representation details may vary as long as the required BIM elements, spatial relationships, geometry ranges, schedules, and sheet text are present.
